name: @social-recall/extension
description: Chrome extension for Social Recall - save LinkedIn profiles with one click

scripts.build: npx tsc src/popup.ts --outDir dist --target ES2017 --lib ES2017,DOM --skipLibCheck && npx tsc src/settings.ts --outDir dist --target ES2017 --lib ES2017,DOM --skipLibCheck
scripts.watch: npx tsc src/popup.ts --outDir dist --target ES2017 --lib ES2017,DOM --skipLibCheck --watch & npx tsc src/settings.ts --outDir dist --target ES2017 --lib ES2017,DOM --skipLibCheck --watch
